The guidance contains '57h 19s' although the preceding baseline is 58m 19s, indicating a transcription error.

global_organization_chain: Race objective and power-duration literature narrow to an individual time-trial decision.
Five prompt tasks are preserved as rider profiles, courses, weather, deviation, and team extension.
Five assumptions and a notation table establish the energy, force, course, and wind interface.
Aerobic and anaerobic fatigue rates are combined into a continuous piecewise power-duration curve.
Gender and rider-type fits turn the physiological interface into parameterized rider profiles.
Altitude, slope, turns, air density, frontal area, drag, and rolling friction define course resistance.
Dynamic programming searches discretized position, energy, and speed states for minimum finish time.
Three courses and rider types are compared through power-distance curves and energy traces.
Wind direction/speed and random execution deviations are tested as separate sensitivity axes.
A six-person extension introduces position-dependent drag, draft, drop, and a fourth-rider criterion.
The guidance memo returns the computed route, rider profile, power-distance instructions, and checkpoint tolerance to action.

main_argument_chains.claim: A fatigue model can constrain rider power over duration and supply a usable rider-specific interface.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Use the fitted curve as a bounded rider constraint rather than a universal physiology law.

main_argument_chains.claim: Course geometry and resistance determine where power should be increased, held, or reduced.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Give position-specific power guidance only for the represented track and rider state.
support_steps: add slope and binary turn conditions

main_argument_chains.claim: Wind and execution deviation alter completion time on the tested grid, but their practical tolerances are local.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Use the sensitivity tables as route-specific operating bands, not population-level uncertainty intervals.
support_steps: measure finish time and checkpoint ranges

main_argument_chains.claim: A team-time-trial extension can represent drafting and dropping through position-dependent resistance, but the paper does not solve it.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Treat team strategy as a proposed model interface until calibration and computation are supplied.
